labels: OWNER campaign approvals for the live PMUS spring probe. A campaign starts ONLY from an entry here whose campaign_id the durable campaign state has not run yet, after the previous campaign is complete and the continuation preflight (every filled market settled with venue-confirmed realized, zero open orders, positions flat) passes. Nothing here changes a per-market cap, the residual cap, concurrency, maker/post-only, the fee-safe completion rule, the deadman, the daily-loss stop or the frozen fidelity gate.

approvals.source: owner direction in chat after #167 comment 5559915772: 'continue Phase-1 evidence collection with a fresh R1 campaign after the current cs2 position has settled and the account is verified flat. This is an R1 evidence continuation, not R2 and not a risk-scale decision.'
approvals.stop_rule_reading: selection stops when the frozen gate reports every LIVE minimum met (live_scored_decisions >= 200, live_markets >= 5, live_post_fill_decisions >= 50, live_timed_intervals >= 50); not before 5 markets merely because 200 decisions arrived first; never manufactured. The daily-loss stop, per-market cap, residual cap, concurrency 1, maker/post-only, fee-safe completion and deadman are the existing R1 controls and bound the campaign.

zero open orders on the venue (orphan sweep sees none)

approvals.not: not R2; not a risk-scale decision; campaigns_per_day for R1 is exceeded by this explicit owner approval only for the evidence continuation

approvals.source: #167 comment 5560851070: 'OWNER DECISION -- behavioral replication proof ACCEPTED. Advance to RUN. Build the smallest next rung that lets materially more of the already-proven L5 policy reach Polymarket ... Prefer changing spend cap + residual cap first ... Fresh rung/cohort/safety-shell label. Preserve R1 evidence immutable. Require account flat + zero open/foreign orders + prior campaign complete before first new first-leg ... No automatic promotion after this rung.'

approvals.stop_rule_reading: 6 filled markets, one at a time, each held to settlement; worst case 6 x $0.15 = $0.90 per campaign, bounded by the unchanged -$1.00 daily realized-loss stop (>= the worst case); campaigns_per_day 1; no automatic promotion afterwards -- the campaign ends at CAMPAIGN_RUNG_COMPLETE for the owner

approvals.source: #167 comment 5561465636: 'OWNER LIVE AUTHORIZATION -- turn on the proven L5 engine with the owner's $110 account, but as a bounded live campaign ... Derive the first real-size rung from L5's observed per-action distribution ... Choose the smallest size that materially tests L5-like execution and, if possible, produces non-rounded maker-rebate evidence ... For the subsequent L5-sized rung, return the exact bounded exposure proposal/preflight and treat this comment as authorization to execute it provided total worst-case loss remains a small bounded fraction of the $110 account and all fail-closed checks pass.'
approvals.rung_derivation: L5 canonical maker actions (55,647): shares p10/p25/p50 = 2/5/10.7, dollars p25/p50 = $0.94/$3.73, window spend p25/p50 = $32/$93, final |residual| p50 = 55 shares; venue maker rebate 0.0125 x C x p(1-p) rounded to the cent needs >= 1.62 shares for one cent at 0.45 -> 5 shares (L5's maker p25) credits $0.01-0.02 per fill at every price in the 35-65 band. Per action $2.50 target (5.0 shares at 0.50), either leg <= $3.25; per-market cap $7.50 = three first legs (23% of L5's p25 window spend); residual cap 6 units (~30 shares, 55% of L5's median final residual); 3 markets, concurrency 1, 6 actions per session.
approvals.stop_rule_reading: 3 filled markets, ONE AT A TIME (OWNER DECISION 5564173746: execution concurrency = 1 for R2C/R3L; the full L5 inventory sequence runs in the selected market until it is terminal, then the engine rotates to the next best), each held to settlement; worst case 3 x $7.50 = $22.50 per campaign (20.5% of the $110 account, only if three consecutive markets lose every first leg with no pair formed); max concurrent open exposure $7.50; the rung's daily realized-loss stop is -$15.00 (13.6%), checked before every session; campaigns_per_day 1; ends at CAMPAIGN_RUNG_COMPLETE for the owner -- no automatic promotion

approvals.source: #167 comment 5567269295: 'OWNER DECISION -- APPROVE R4, with one accounting/economic guardrail. The 5567227181 analysis is accepted ... Authorize R4 as proposed: per-action sizing unchanged from R3L: max $2.50 / ~5 shares as executable; per-market unmatched-dollar-at-risk cap: $2.50; completion bound: 1.00 max pair cost (from 0.98); concurrency 1; maker-only; broad sports scan + pair_score ranking; deadman/reconciliation unchanged; daily realized-loss stop remains -$15; max 3 markets / $7.50 campaign worst-case as proposed; fresh R4 rung/cohort/approval identity; preserve R3L immutable. Guardrail: ... do not operationally spend rebate beyond par yet. Keep the hard live pair-cost ceiling at 1.00 for R4 even if the estimated rebate breakeven is ~1.003.'
approvals.rung_derivation: R3L (19 fills, 19/19 maker, net balance change -$1.5302 reconciled to the cent as -6.2855 venue realized + 1.0825 + 3.3928 derived pair cash + 0.2800 venue-credited rebates) reproduced L5's own economic structure: pairs and incentives positive, residual negative. L5 residual envelope (analysis/l5/l5_residual_risk.json, 2,216 windows): unmatched exposure in every window, held to settlement in 98.96%, win rate 0.4993, residual P&L -$19,963 -- a coin flip that loses; at material size peak unmatched was 10.8-13.7% of deployed capital, which at our $7.50 cap is $1.03, below one action, so one action ($2.50) is the tightest implementable dollar cap. The live selection that chose the losing R3L market carried pair_at_touch 0.99, above the 0.98 bound, and every later decision logged complement_not_priceable; the measured maker rebate (0.808% of filled dollars, $0.0033/share) pays for a pair up to ~1.003, so par is the evidence-backed ceiling and the owner's guardrail makes it HARD.
approvals.stop_rule_reading: 3 filled markets, ONE AT A TIME, each held to settlement; dollars AT RISK are the unmatched ones (a matched pair pays $1 whatever happens): at most $2.50 per market, so the campaign worst case is 3 x $2.50 = $7.50 (6.9% of the $108.9985 balance at approval); capital DEPLOYED stays bounded by the unchanged $7.50 per-market spend cap (3 x $7.50 = $22.50, still required as buying power by the sized-rung preflight); the -$15.00 daily realized-loss stop is unchanged; campaigns_per_day 1; ends at CAMPAIGN_RUNG_COMPLETE for the owner -- 'No automatic R5 promotion. At 3 settled markets, stop and report.'
approvals.changed: exactly two levers: (1) the residual cap becomes DOLLARS -- an OPEN/EXTEND that would leave more than $2.50 unmatched is refused before submission under its own name (unmatched_usd_cap), classified separately from residual_cap/spend_cap so the owner can see whether it blocked L5-consistent actions; an order that reduces unmatched exposure is never refused; (2) the completion ceiling rises 0.98 -> 1.00 for COMPLETE (deficit-side) orders only, as a HARD ceiling -- never above par, rebate never spent beyond par -- while the >=1c-after-known-fees rule still governs OPEN/EXTEND
approvals.unchanged: $2.50 per action (~5 shares), either leg <= $3.25, $7.50 per-market spend cap, 6 behavioral residual units as the EXTEND bound (the dollar cap binds first), 3 markets, concurrency 1, maker/post-only, ONE session at a time and ONE outstanding order, HOLD residual to settlement, 6 actions per session, deadman/cancel, orphan sweep, settlement/realized accounting from the venue only, rebates counted only when venue-credited, the frozen fidelity gate and its thresholds, the frozen L5 v2 policy and canonical lookup v3; the 0.35-0.65 / <=0.98 OBSERVATION cap for admission is untouched
